# Consolidation Checklist: PRD Agent Folder Consolidation

**Purpose**: Requirements quality validation for skill consolidation, agent definitions, documentation, and registry updates across all phases (setup, foundational, user stories, polish, convergence)

**Created**: 2026-09-17  
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [tasks.md](../tasks.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer (author or PR reviewer) determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.

**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does NOT mean implementation work is complete. Author uses this for self-validation before PR; reviewer uses it during PR review.

**Timing**: Release/integration gate — validate comprehensively before merge to develop.

---

## Skill Consolidation Requirements (FR-001 through FR-003)

**Focus**: Merge rules, cluster audits, duplication detection, content reconciliation

- [ ] CHK001 Are the 17 skill clusters and their consolidation verdicts (keep/merge/delete) explicitly enumerated in SKILL_DUPLICATION_AUDIT_REPORT.md? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the reconciliation procedure for divergent files (e.g., `support-transition-rules.md`) clearly specified with decision criteria? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the naming conventions consistent when promoting skills (e.g., `hermes/lightspeed-qa-planner` → `qa-planner`)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK004 Is it explicitly documented which "generic tier" skills are being kept vs. retired (the 10-skill scope in SC-007)? [Completeness, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK005 Are union-merge requirements documented for the 3 forked skills' `references/` folders (approval-gate-manager, project-memory-manager, release-handoff-generator)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK006 Can "no duplicate skill names" be objectively verified (e.g., via `find . -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d | sort | uniq -d`)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the final canonical skill count (28, or 27 after frontend-skill removal) explicitly documented as a success criterion? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK008 Are the edge cases for skill merge conflicts documented (e.g., what if two skills have incompatible SKILL.md descriptions)? [Coverage, Gap]

## Agent Definition Requirements (FR-004, FR-009, User Story 2)

**Focus**: Claude/Copilot loadability, frontmatter contracts, manifest accuracy

- [ ] CHK009 Are the required YAML frontmatter fields for Claude Code agents explicitly documented (name, description, tools, model)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the required YAML frontmatter fields for Copilot agents explicitly documented (name, description, tools, mcp-servers)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the "unmodified copy" requirement for agent definitions tested against both Claude Code and Copilot loading behavior? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002/SC-003]
- [ ] CHK012 Are the model IDs in `claude/agent.md` and `copilot/agent.md` frozen/pinned to specific versions, or are they flexible? [Clarity, Gap]
- [ ] CHK013 Are there documented fallback behaviors if a tool in the `tools:` list becomes unavailable? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the MCP server list for `copilot/agent.md` documented and validated against available MCP servers? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK015 Are the Integration Points section and capability tags from `prd-factory-planner-agent/AGENT.md` ported into `agents/prd-agent/AGENT.md` with source traceability? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK016 Can the agent definitions be validated by a linting tool (e.g., `npm run validate:frontmatter`)? [Measurability, Gap]

## Documentation Requirements (FR-005, FR-006, User Story 3)

**Focus**: README accuracy, AGENT.md completeness, AGENTS.md routing, dangling link detection

- [ ] CHK017 Does the new `README.md` describe the consolidated folder structure without boilerplate or export cruft? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK018 Are all links in `README.md` validated to point at real skill folders and documented capabilities? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK019 Does `AGENT.md` list all 28 (or 27) canonical skills with their SKILL.md links? [Completeness, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the skill-routing section in `instructions/AGENTS.md` rewritten with NO dead session IDs or fabricated skill names? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK021 Are the routing entries in `instructions/AGENTS.md` validated to match real skill names and folder paths? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the removal of Codex export boilerplate from original `README.md` complete and documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK023 Is there a lint/validation command that can verify zero dangling links across README, AGENT.md, and AGENTS.md? [Measurability, Gap]
- [ ] CHK024 Are capability tags defined and consistently applied across all documented skills? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004]

## Registry & Tracking Requirements (FR-010, Phase 4/7 dependencies)

**Focus**: `memory-registry.yaml` entries, `inventory-lock.json`, tracking accuracy, external system consistency

- [ ] CHK025 Is the relationship between `agents/prd-agent/copilot/agent.md` and the `agents/mode-prd.agent.md` registry entry documented and decided (retire/sync/defer)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK026 Are the `memory-registry.yaml` entries for the PRD agent updated with the new consolidated folder path? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK027 Is `inventory-lock.json` updated to reflect the consolidated skill list (28 skills, no hermes/ subfolder, no prd-factory-planner-agent/)? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK028 Are the memory profile and example files (`mode-prd.memory-profile.yaml`, `mode-prd.memory.example.yaml`) retiring or repointing to the new agent location? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the registry entry format validation documented (e.g., against `contracts/memory-registry-entry.md`)? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK030 Can registry consistency be validated with a cross-reference check (e.g., entries in `memory-registry.yaml` match actual files on disk)? [Measurability, Gap]

## Cross-Phase Dependencies & Ordering (All Phases)

**Focus**: Phase sequencing, blocking relationships, cleanup ordering

- [ ] CHK031 Is the Phase 3 dependency on Phase 1 decisions (T002, T003, T004 in DECISIONS_LOG.md) documented and validated? [Completeness, Spec §Phase 3]
- [ ] CHK032 Is the Phase 5 hard dependency on Phase 3 completion (skill list must be finalized before documentation is accurate) explicitly stated? [Completeness, Spec §Phase 5]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the cleanup ordering documented (e.g., T023 porting before T024 deletion to prevent content loss)? [Clarity, Spec §tasks.md T023-T024]
- [ ] CHK034 Are the deletion tasks (T012, T016, T018, T019, T020, T024, T026, T039, T040, T050) ordered AFTER their respective merge/port tasks? [Consistency, Spec §tasks.md]

- [ ] CHK038 Is "zero dangling links" measurable via a grep/link-validation script? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]

## Edge Cases & Fallback Scenarios (All Phases)

**Focus**: Error handling, missing data, reconciliation conflicts

- [ ] CHK040 Is fallback behavior documented if a skill's `SKILL.md` file is corrupted or missing? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK041 Are version compatibility requirements documented for the consolidated agent in Claude Code and Copilot? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK042 Is recovery procedure documented if a merge conflict cannot be resolved (e.g., two skills have genuinely incompatible requirements)? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK043 Are deprecation/migration paths documented for downstream consumers using old `prd-factory-planner-agent/` references? [Coverage, Gap]
